title: The Forgotten Preparation
description: Harlan can't forge — the preparation step keeps vanishing from his routine.

healMoment.visual: Harlan's anvil stops flickering. Warm orange and gold ripple across the forge.
healMoment.audio: Forge crackling normalizes. Three-note ascending chime plays.

npcReaction.speaker: Harlan
npcReaction.text: I can feel it. The rhythm — it's back.

npcReaction.speaker: Harlan
npcReaction.text: Prepare, then forge. How did I ever forget?

healMoment.worldChange: Forge area restored. Anvil stable. Smoke steady.

_creatorNote.realWorldParallel: Hooks validate state before actions execute.
